# 3 bedroom semi-detached house for sale

> Situated in the sought-after village of Galgate, Rose Grove offers an excellent setting for this three-bedroom semi-detached home, combining a peaceful residential environment with superb convenience. The area enjoys a strong community feel and a semi-rural charm, making it particularly appealing to families and professionals alike.

- Vlastnictví: Freehold
- Energetická náročnost: D
